originalInscription: A promise once broken, waiting to be fulfilled.

npcs.carrying: You brought Tears for Fears back. Good work, traveller. A fine blade deserves hands that remember who it was made to protect.
npcs.fulfilled: You kept the promise through to the end. I will remember that.

npcs.carrying: Tears for Fears, recovered at last. Congratulations. Keep asking careful questions; possession is not the same as understanding.
npcs.fulfilled: Now the record holds another truth: you chose to fulfil the promise yourself.

npcs.carrying: So that is Tears for Fears in working hands again. Well done. Keep its purpose as carefully as you keep its edge.
npcs.fulfilled: You carried the work further than a repaired workshop. That matters.

npcs.carrying: You recovered the blade. You have my respect. Carry it for the people beside you, not for the praise it might bring.
npcs.fulfilled: The promise you fulfilled was yours to choose. I am glad you chose to keep it.

npcs.carrying: Tears for Fears has returned. May it shelter the living. Congratulations, traveller; remember that strength does not make another person yours to spend.
npcs.fulfilled: What you gave freely will be remembered here.

npcs.carrying: The stolen blade is back in our world. Well done. The people who kept these outposts standing would have wanted to see this.
npcs.fulfilled: You did more than recover what was lost. You gave the old promise a future.

npcs.carrying: You brought Tears for Fears back. I will give you that, and gladly. Do not forget the people whose names never made the grand accounts.
npcs.fulfilled: You kept your own promise. That earns a kind of trust no banner can demand.

npcs.carrying: The recovery of Tears for Fears is no longer a rumour. Congratulations. I will record what you achieved without pretending it answers every question.
npcs.fulfilled: Your freely chosen act belongs in the record, under your own name.

npcs.carrying: Tears for Fears, here at last. Congratulations on its recovery. Treat what we learned as a responsibility, not permission to stop learning.
npcs.fulfilled: You carried the unfinished work beyond these instruments. I am glad to have witnessed it.

npcs.carrying: I saw that blade fall into the enemy's keeping. Seeing it carried out again is more than I expected. Well done.
npcs.fulfilled: The last watchfire no longer marks only a loss. You gave us something else to remember.

npcs.carrying: Relic recovery confirmed: Tears for Fears. Congratulations, bearer. Preserve both the instrument and the purpose recorded with it.
npcs.fulfilled: Personal fulfilment confirmed. This record belongs to you, bearer.

npcs.carrying: Tears for Fears has found its way back. Congratulations, traveller. What you choose to protect will give its strength meaning.
npcs.fulfilled: The promise was freely chosen and personally fulfilled. The forest remembers.
